newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation quickens to 0.3 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation quickens to 0.3 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have accelerated in the week ended June 9 to 0.3 percent from 0.1 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
The monthly inflation rate in May was 0.9 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended June 9 June 2
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.7 +0.3
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.073 +0.042
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
Consumer prices have risen by 7.8 percent so far since the start of the year.
